messages:
ben (ae): Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp POC hitting really inconsistent TTFT during concurrency tests. Sometimes first token is ~1200ms, sometimes 4s, and a few requests 10s+ and time out. They're worried about SLA and want pricing for reserved capacity + a short remediation plan.

alex: ugh. do we have an instrumentation trace or logs from their run?

ben (ae): sent the run bucket via S3 link earlier today: s3://redwood-poc-acme/2026-03-20/runs/seed-42.log — they ran 50 concurrent sessions with dynamic prompts.

marta: two quick suspects: 1) batching policy mismatch with very variable seq lengths 2) cold KV cache + no prefix warmup -> first-token spikes. Also check if they're hitting our queuing fallback (swarm -> burst).

raj: adding a quick log snippet they pasted:

```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z request_id=abcd1234 model=gpt-2x variant=quantized seq_len=18 status=queued reason=batch_full
2026-03-20T18:12:04Z request_id=abcd1234 status=started runtime_ms=1250 kv_cache_miss=true
2026-03-20T18:12:08Z request_id=efgh5678 status=429 error=queue_full
2026-03-20T18:12:10Z request_id=ijkl9012 status=started runtime_ms=4020 kv_cache_miss=true
```

raj: that 429 + batch_full suggests intermittent queue saturation and cold-KV for some sessions. If they use short lived sessions with new prefixes, cache warming matters.

priya: Do they use streaming? streaming + batching can sometimes serialize things oddly if client doesn't read continuously.

ben (ae): they're streaming but each client connects for ~5-10s, sends new prompt, closes. No sustained session pinning.

alex: okay. two practical fixes to propose now: 1) recommend small prefill/warmup calls per session (1-2 short tokens) to populate KV for that prefix 2) adjust batching window to be slightly larger for this POC so variance smooths out. Also offer Dedicated burst credits if they need predictable tail latency.

marta: can we share a quick curl snippet for prefill?

alex: sure — example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/gpt-2x/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"", "max_tokens":1, "prefill":true}'
```

marta: nice. Also suggest usage of token-level tracing for a sample 20 requests so we can correlate which ones hit queue_full. Ask them to enable `x-rw-trace: true` header and send back the trace bundle.

ben (ae): i'll send them the steps + ask for traces. Also they're asking about pricing: what do I say for 2-week POC with ~200k tokens/day and 50 concurrent sessions?

marta: for short-term POC, suggest our POC burst credits + usage pricing — estimate: usage fees apply, but we can offer temporary reserved capacity credits (talk to sales ops). I'll loop in finance after we get their exact token profile.

raj: ops note: if they need immediate tail SLO guarantees, Dedicated is the only way to hit strict latency SLOs under high concurrency. Otherwise suggest autoscale with higher min replicas + pre-warmed KV.

ben (ae): security questionnaire — they asked for our network egress and KMS details. Is there a short doc link I can send?

marta: send them https://redwood.ai/security/presales-summary (internal view) and ask them to fill the attached customer questionnaire — we can fast-track with security once completed.

deploy-bot: deployment v2.14.1 succeeded in stg (runtime improvements for batching). :rocket:

alex: FYI we just shipped small batching improvement in stg — might reduce those queue_full events. Recommend they re-run their run against the stg flag we can enable on their account for 24h.

ben (ae): perfect. I'll propose this action plan to Acme: 1) enable stg batching improvements on their account for 24h 2) do prefill warmups (curl snippet) 3) collect 20 token-level traces with `x-rw-trace` 4) share token profile for pricing + request security questionnaire. Will ask for an end-of-day check-in tomorrow.

marta: assign internal owners: alex -> trace + warmup instructions, raj -> queuing/batching config suggestions, priya -> streaming client checklist, ben -> customer comms + pricing ask. :thumbsup:

ben (ae): thanks all — i'll post update after Acme runs tests.

alex: ping me here when they upload traces, i'll start correlation.

raj: if they hit queue_full again, capture a few IDs and we'll do a live swarm with oncall.

ben (ae): noted — closing loop for now.
